steps.evidence: .github/workflows/tests.yml:57; panel uses ->viteTheme() (AdminPanelProvider.php:28) and layouts use @vite, so a Vite manifest or running dev server is needed

notes: `composer setup` (composer.json:68-75) copies .env.example to .env if missing, php artisan key:generate, touches database/database.sqlite, php artisan migrate, php artisan db:seed, php artisan storage:link. The README stops there, but the Filament panel registers a Vite theme (resources/css/filament/admin/theme.css) and public/build is gitignored, so without `npm install` + `npm run build` (or `npm run dev`) pages fail with a Vite manifest error; CI and the maintainer agent script both run npm ci + npm run build, and CLAUDE.md:200 mentions the manifest error. SQLite (DB_CONNECTION=sqlite), no services; CI uses Postgres only for one schema-reset test. PHP: composer.json says ^8.1, but the lockfile needs >=8.4.1 (Symfony 8 packages) and CI uses 8.4, so 8.4 is the real floor. Node 20 from CI (no engines/.nvmrc). Login admin@filamentphp.com / password per README.
